QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Preparing a Perfect Debut
QuestInfo.0: Jackpot Entertainment's new group takes an overwhelming lead in the text-in qualification vote, becoming the newest group to compete on Kerning City Superstars!  All that remains is to prepare for a flawless debut.
QuestInfo.1: You agree to help with the debut preparations for the Jackpot agency's new group by hiring a hairstylist and makeup artist. They are in #r#m103041140##k and #r#m103041150##k. In the name of Jackpot Entertainment, you will find them, and you will hire them!
QuestInfo.2: You helped with the debut preparations for the Jackpot agency's new group and hired a hairstylist and makeup artist.

0.0: After many twists and turns, Jackpot Entertainment has found itself not one, but five new singers. And after all this time, people will finally hear my music again. All that remains is a successful debut...
0.1: Since Dia Mandy has joined the group, I'm officially down one secretary... There's a lot of work to do before the girls debut.
0.2: So... do you think you could fill in for her? Pleeeease? You've already completed all your duties as casting manager.

yes.0: I just got off the phone with the show. The schedule for our broadcast debut is all set. What we need now, is to ensure that the girls look their best. \r\nThere are lots of talented beauticians in #rKerning Tower#k. I'm counting on you to find us a hair stylist and makeup artist.
yes.1: If I were you, I'd start my search at #r#m103041140##k and #r#m103041150##k. Remember, it's only the best for our girls! But, uh, find somebody willing to work on consignment...

no.0: We've managed to secure a spot on Kerning City Superstars, but theres so much to prepare and so little time!

1.0: Oh, you're back! Did you find a suitable hairstylist and makeup artist?

yes.0: I knew you could do it! Whew, what a relief. All that's left is for me to pick up the girls' costumes, and our preparations are complete!
yes.1: Just the thought of the girls going on stage... (Sniffs) It's so touching! I remember how I felt on my own debut...
yes.2: Well, it's up to the girls now. The debut is just around the corner. I guess there's nothing left for the two of us but to sit back and relax while they practice!

default.0: If I were you, I'd start my search at #r#m103041140##k and #r#m103041150##k. Remember, it's only the best for our girls! But, uh, find somebody willing to work on consignment...
